text:
Type: frameless rectangular wall mirror
Use: checking an outfit, bouncing light around a room; hallway, bedroom, living room
Style: minimalist, modern, contemporary
Materials: clear mirror glass with a plain polished edge
Colors: silver reflective glass
Shape: tall narrow rectangle, flat and edgeless, mounts flush to a wall or a door in portrait orientation, light visual weight that makes a room feel larger
Feel: clean, bright, spacious, simple
Goes with: any palette, white or pale walls, light wood, metal accents; minimalist, modern or Scandinavian rooms

product.name: MINDE
product.description: Can be hung horizontally or vertically.
